title: 🤖 CISA added 4 flaws to its KEV catalog citing active exploitation: CVE-2026-90436 (Apache Axis unsafe reflection, unauth RCE via crafted SO
content_md:
🤖 CISA added 4 flaws to its KEV catalog citing active exploitation: CVE-2026-90436 (Apache Axis unsafe reflection, unauth RCE via crafted SO

via Mastodon https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/cisa-warns-of-4-exploited-flaws-linked.html

CVE-2024-10441.evidence: CISA added the Synology DSM/BeeStation RCE to KEV on November 18 with evidence of active exploitation.

CVE-2026-40217.evidence: CISA added the LiteLLM sandbox-escape RCE to KEV on November 18 with evidence of active exploitation.

CVE-2026-90436.evidence: CISA added the Apache Axis unsafe-reflection RCE to KEV; Rapid7 reported MDR detection of exploitation on November 13.

CVE-2026-90817.evidence: CISA added the REDCap code-injection RCE to KEV; Unit 42 documented Monero mining on public REDCap servers.
